verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency about minimum seats or annual commitments is a fair question for a SaaS product, but the evidence pack never says whether any Basecamp plan has a seat minimum or requires annual billing. The free-tier cap ('Invite up to 3 people') is a maximum on a free plan, not a minimum seat requirement. Self-serve cancellation is a related but different policy and does not say anything about billing-term commitments.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
